name: Cat Sith

attributes.attribute: was a fairy in disguise to some
was a witch in cat form to others

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: The Cat Sith is a dark cat of the Highlands of Scotland. People supposed this animal was a fairy in disguise. Others counted it a witch in cat form.

okr.objective: The Cat Sith is a dark Highland cat believed to hide a fairy or witch.
key_results: It was a huge dark cat.
It lived in the Highlands of Scotland.
Some saw it as a disguised fairy.
Some saw it as a witch in cat form.
